submission.natural_language_explanation: Broad layer-0 previous-token mover that is weakly to moderately active on most ordinary prose (sentence peaks typically 1-2, above the ~0.7 line) because at each position it forwards the immediately preceding token; its write deviates maximally (2.5-3.7) when the forwarded source is a contentful token such as 'one', 'each', 'view', a word-initial piece, or 'and'/'the', and stays near its mean write below the line when the only available source is the bleached items 'of'/'to' (or a copula like 'is'), so 'X of' peaks scale with X ('one of' ~3.6, 'of of' ~1.2, 'to of' ~0.4) and runs of 'of'/'to' sit fully below the line while runs of 'and'/'the' ride well above it.

rival_explanations: Exact-bigram 'one of' detector: fires only when 'of' immediately follows 'one', so 'One person', 'Light energy' and repeated 'and and' should all be inactive.
Uniform 'of' responder: every 'of' peaks near the maximum regardless of its predecessor, so 'of of', 'to of' and 'of' after 'is' should all hit ~3.0.
